text:
maya (eng-platform): quick idea: add a single stable header `X-RW-Error-Bucket` + optional `X-RW-Error-Detail` so SDKs/console can show consistent copy without adding new HTTP codes.
sam (eng-runtime): +1. Prefer buckets be low-cardinality. We keep 429/503 as-is but bucket tells UX what to show.
li (prod-ux): need canonical one-line text per bucket and a demo in console. Also a small developer hint for SDKs.
noah (eng-infra): telemetry note: index `error_bucket` as a tag, sample `error_detail`. Add a code registry to prevent drift.
maya (eng-platform): proposed buckets: quota, backpressure, bad_request, auth. detail values are short enums like 'soft_limit' or 'capacity_full'.
docs-bot: docs reminder: include migration steps for old ad-hoc error strings.
sam (eng-runtime): example header payload:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RW-Error-Bucket: quota
X-RW-Error-Detail: soft_limit
X-RW-Hint: retry-after=5;reduce_concurrency=true
li (prod-ux): sample console text: quota.soft_limit -> "You're nearing your quota. Lower concurrency or enable batching."
noah (eng-infra): sanitize hint values before logging and limit hint keys to a safe whitelist. we'll sample verbose hints.
maya (eng-platform): rollout plan: canary 5% internal, collect `error_bucket` metrics, patch SDKs to expose bucket/detail but not auto-retry. will file RFC with enums and deprecation window. reviewers: @sam @li @noah
sam (eng-runtime): will prepare small runtime flag to toggle headers per host.
li (prod-ux): I'll mock the console preview UI and publish example strings for localization.
docs-bot: I'll create the docs page skeleton and add translation notes.
maya (eng-platform): great. let's decide exact enum names in the RFC and lock the registry before broad rollout. :thumbsup:
